1.explanation:
• Toggle.js: this is where the hideLabel and ariaLabelledby props are defined and documented via JSDoc/PropTypes. We need to augment those comments to indicate that hideLabel requires an external accessible label (aria-labelledby or aria-label).  
• Toggle.mdx: this MDX file drives the prop table in Storybook. We must update the descriptions for aria-labelledby and hideLabel to call out the dependency and show an example.  
• Toggle.stories.js: the example stories should include a variant demonstrating hideLabel working correctly with aria-labelledby (and note that hideLabel alone won’t hide the label). Adding a note or new story will guide users immediately from the demo.
1.bug_scenario: When users set hideLabel={true} on the <Toggle> component, they expect the visible label to disappear immediately. Instead, hideLabel alone only moves the labelText to the side (and the label remains in the DOM), and the default “hidden” behavior only kicks in when an aria-labelledby attribute is also supplied. This dependency isn’t documented anywhere in the storybook docs or PropTypes comments, so users aren’t aware they must supply aria-labelledby (or aria-label) for hideLabel to truly remove the visible label. The supplied screenshots show hideLabel alone does not hide the label, and that adding aria-labelledby makes it disappear. The current prop table in Toggle.mdx simply says “Specify whether the label should be hidden” with no mention of the aria-labelledby requirement.

2.explanation:
1. packages/react/src/components/Toggle/Toggle.js – This is where the hideLabel and aria-labelledby props are defined (propTypes/defaultProps) and where the implementation enforces that hideLabel only hides the label when aria-labelledby is present. We need to update the JSDoc above these props to explain the interdependency (or change the implementation if we remove the requirement).  
2. packages/react/src/components/Toggle/Toggle.stories.js – Storybook stories drive the interactive examples and controls table. We should enhance or override the argTypes for hideLabel and aria-labelledby to include detailed descriptions so that users see the relationship in the controls panel.  
3. packages/react/src/components/Toggle/Toggle.mdx – This MDX file powers the Toggle component’s documentation page in Storybook. It currently pulls in <Props /> with no additional commentary. We need to add explanatory text around hideLabel and aria-labelledby (for example, in the API table or as callouts) so it’s clear how to use these props together (or note that hideLabel will be simplified in a future release).
2.bug_scenario: When using the Carbon React Toggle component with hideLabel={true}, users expect the labelText to be hidden immediately. In reality, hideLabel by itself only repositions the label (it moves it to the side instead of hiding it), and the label will only be truly hidden if the aria-labelledby prop is also provided. None of this nuance is documented in the storybook docs or in the component’s prop descriptions. The ask is to update the Toggle’s documentation and stories so that it’s clear hideLabel requires aria-labelledby to actually hide the label, or to simplify the API so hideLabel works by itself.
